ordinary: All 18620 ordinary directional records, six-direction equal weights, strict oriented IoU > 0.25 and > 0.50. Retain every fallback and negative.
controlled: Replay all 1204 historical panel and 128 noun records for output equivalence. Score the locked 64 same-frame noun pairs separately for both endpoints.
scale_rule: Use original quantiles, retain levels 1,3,6,8 for four, 3,6 for two and 4 for one. Drop unavailable nodes, link to nearest surviving ancestor and renormalize proposal votes in each inventory.
lexical_rule: Remove noun evidence or the dimension multiplier only from class probabilities; retain the full stop probability and the same geometry completion.
geometry_rule: Geometry changes apply at identical selected nodes; keep fallback terrain except for the named fallback arm. Remove horizontal or vertical component separately; symmetric horizontal changes anchoring only.
decision: Ordinary outcomes of variants are descriptive. Exact simplification requires identical endpoint decisions and emitted coordinates over every tested input form; compare changes on controlled expressions too. Retain full as registered unless an equivalence is established; report tradeoffs for empirical pruning.
uncertainty: Resample target recordings jointly across source arms within each target, 4000 fixed-seed draws. Intervals exploratory on reused recordings.
